## Which alternative fits which situation?# [...] ### Dial, for similar calling rates and WhatsApp#

Dial is another developer service that sells numbers, calls and texts for AI agents. It lists $3.00 a number per month, $0.13 a minute when your own AI handles calls, $0.22 when Dial runs the AI, and $0.02 a US message. AgentPhone charges $0.02 per text segment, so a long message can cost several segments. The identical numeric text rates use different billing units. Dial also offers WhatsApp, and an Apple iMessage number costs $250 a month. It works with the coding tools Claude Code, Cursor and Codex, and with OpenClaw and Hermes, which are AI agents that run tasks for you.

### Vapi, if you're building a voice product# [...] ### Twilio, if you want to build it yourself#

Twilio is a phone provider that sells lines to developers. Its pricing pages list a US local number at $1.15 a month, calls out at $0.0140 a minute and texts at $0.0083 a segment, plus mobile network fees. You build the agent on top, choosing the AI model, the speech-to-text and the voice yourself. Building on Twilio makes sense when you want to own every part. Bland is an official Twilio partner. Twilio hasn't reviewed this list.
